meta_description:
21K likes, 539 comments - bigleemurali on April 10, 2022: "It's official
Dr. Murali Vijayakumar 

Happy to let you all know that the IACHRC (intergovernmental body within the United Nations) has awarded me the Honorary Doctorate for my work in the field of fitness and sports. 

Proud to have received it from the hands of the  honorable Justice Dr. T. N. Vallinayagam (High Court Judge and Chairman of National Cyber Defense Research Center)

Note - Actor M. S. Bhaskar was also awarded Doctorate for his work in the field of arts and entertainment .

Eductionalist Usha Natrajan was also awarded Doctorate for her work in the field of education.

#biglee #fitness #sports #doctratre #service #gym #diet #recognition #fit #cinema #school #nsn #tamilcinema".
